cardEffects.mackerel_boat: If you have Harbor, get 3 coins from the bank.
cardEffects.tuna_boat: If you have Harbor, roll both dice and get that many coins.
cardEffects.cheese_factory: Get 3 coins per Ranch you own.
cardEffects.furniture_factory: Get 3 coins per Forest or Mine you own.
cardEffects.farmers_market: Get 2 coins per wheat-symbol card you own.
cardEffects.flower_shop: Get 1 coin per Flower Garden you own.
cardEffects.food_warehouse: If you have Harbor, get 2 coins per cup-symbol card you own.
cardEffects.cafe: Take 1 coin from the active player.
cardEffects.family_restaurant: Take 2 coins from the active player.
cardEffects.sushi_bar: If you have Harbor, take 3 coins from the active player.
cardEffects.hamburger_stand: Take 1 coin from the active player.
cardEffects.pizza_joint: Take 1 coin from the active player.
cardEffects.tv_station: Take 5 coins from any one opponent.
cardEffects.business_center: Trade one non-Major establishment with an opponent.
cardEffects.publisher: Take 1 coin per cup/bread symbol card from each opponent.
cardEffects.tax_office: Take half coins (rounded down) from each opponent with 10+ coins.
cardEffects.corn_field: If you have 1 or fewer landmarks, get 1 coin from the bank.
cardEffects.general_store: On your turn, if you have 1 or fewer landmarks, get 2 coins from the bank.
cardEffects.soda_bottling_plant: Get 1 coin for each Restaurant (red) establishment owned by all players.
cardEffects.french_restaurant: If the active player has 2+ landmarks, take 5 coins from them.
cardEffects.private_club: If the active player has 3+ landmarks, take all their coins.
cardEffects.winery: Get 6 coins per Vineyard you own, then this card closes for renovation.
cardEffects.cleaning_company: Close every copy of one non-Major establishment across all players for renovation; collect 1 coin per copy closed.
cardEffects.loan_office: When built, take 5 coins from the bank. When activated, pay 2 coins to the bank.
cardEffects.tech_startup: On your turn you may invest 1 coin onto this card. When activated, each opponent pays you the total invested.
cardEffects.park: Pool all coins from all players and redistribute them equally (remainder to the active player).
cardEffects.demolition_company: Demolish one of your constructed landmarks (not City Hall), then get 8 coins from the bank.
cardEffects.moving_company: Give one of your non-Major establishments to another player, then get 4 coins from the bank.
cardEffects.city_hall: After income, if you have 0 coins, get 1 coin from the bank.
cardEffects.harbor: When you roll 10+, you may add 2 to the total.
cardEffects.train_station: You may choose to roll 1 or 2 dice each turn.
cardEffects.shopping_mall: Your cup and bread establishments earn +1 coin each.
cardEffects.amusement_park: If you roll doubles, take another turn.
cardEffects.radio_tower: Once per turn, you may reroll the dice.
cardEffects.airport: If you do not build, get 10 coins.

landing.heroSubtitle: Roll the dice, earn coins, and grow your village into a bustling city — the beloved tabletop classic, playable live in your browser.
landing.cardsSubtitle: A faithful digital build — every card, family and payout works just like the tabletop game.
landing.feature1Body: Every die roll, coin and card purchase is resolved on the server, so the rules stay consistent and no one can cheat.
landing.feature2Body: In-game sounds for rolls, coins and builds, plus quick emoji reactions to liven up your table.
landing.strategyBody: Mix establishments across four card families and race to build your landmarks before your rivals do.
landing.family1Body: Blue cards pay you on anyone's roll; green cards pay on your own turn.
landing.family2Body: Red cards take coins from whoever just rolled.
landing.family3Body: Purple power plays — and the landmarks you must build to win.
landing.ctaBody: The town square is empty and the citizens are waiting. Start your first city today.
landing.footerTagline: A digital build on the Tabletop Hearth design system.
